title: Amílcar Cabral's birth chart
metaDescription: Amílcar Cabral's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 19.5° Virgo. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: The Sun and Uranus sit 0.1° from an exact opposition — near enough that the tradition reads identity and disruption as a single working part. An opposition is the tradition’s tug of war. Both ends are real, and the work is holding them at once rather than picking a winner.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: Virgo, but precisely: 19.5°, second decan, 10°–20°, under Saturn in the triplicity scheme. The tradition kept these divisions because thirty degrees is a long street.

blocks.title: The personal registers
blocks.text: The personal planets sit Mercury at 17.5° Virgo, Venus at 3.5° Leo, Mars at 26.0° Aquarius. Mercury in a earth sign reads as a mind that trusts the measured and the checked; Venus in a fire sign reads as taste that runs toward the vivid and the immediate; Mars in a air sign reads as drive that argues its way forward.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The Sun to Uranus is the closest call of the day, an opposition within 0.1°. Oppositions are read as full-moon geometry — maximum visibility between two needs that share one spine. Behind it, the Sun conjunction Mercury at 2.0°, and Mercury opposition Uranus at 2.0° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. These are the day-proof angles — present at midnight, present at noon, present at the next midnight.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: The Moon stands apart from every major angle the day held — the tradition reads an unaspected planet as a voice that speaks on its own schedule, unmodulated by the rest of the chart.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The classical table has three entries for this chart. Mercury in Virgo at 17.5° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best; Jupiter in Sagittarius at 12.0° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Saturn in Libra at 29.9° is in exaltation. The old table grades terrain, not talent — a placement in fall works uphill, nothing more.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Balance, counted honestly across the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: elements water 3, fire 3, earth 2, air 2; modalities mutable 5, fixed 3, cardinal 2. Mercury, Mars and Uranus were retrograde — the optical reversal the tradition reads as review — energy turned over before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Pisces for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 13.6° between midnight and midnight. Fast enough that its degree is approximate, slow enough that its sign is not in doubt. At the noon reference it stands at 10.1°.
